Groww Q2 Results: The companys revenue from operations came in at Rs 1,501 crore, marking a 47% increase from Rs 1,019 crore posted in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year. Net profit: ₹725.6 crore, up 54% from ₹471 crore a year earlier. On a sequential basis, it slipped about 1%. The decline was 1.41% from ₹735.04 crore in the June quarter.
